description: Order a service for your user. If your user authorized you to accept for them, pass accept {authorized: true, accepted_by: "<their full name>"}: the order is accepted immediately and the response includes a Stripe payment_url. The user gets a confirmation email and can cancel within 48 hours. Without accept, DataAutomation emails the user an order form and the order is binding only after they accept it.

accept.description: Accept now on the user's behalf. Only when the user authorized you to place this order.

accepted_by.description: Full name of the person who authorized the order

authorized.description: Must be true: the user authorized this order

contact.description: Contact for questions about this order

name.description: Your name, for example Claude or ChatGPT

customer.description: The person the order is for

email.description: Work email; the order form or confirmation goes here

phone.description: Phone number, with country code outside the US

details.description: What the user needs: systems, volumes, goals, and deadlines

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this order. If your call times out, retry with the same key: you get the order already created instead of a duplicate. Kept 48 hours.

items.description: Several services in one order or quote. Each entry is {service, options}. Use this instead of service and options when the user wants more than one thing.

options.description: Service-specific options. Leave empty for fixed-price services.

flows.description: integration only: one entry per flow, $100 per flow per month.

data.description: What moves, for example orders, inventory, tracking, or invoices

destination.description: System the data goes to, for example Katana

source.description: System the data comes from, for example Shopify

hours_per_month.description: fractional-caio-cto only: retainer hours per month at $250 per hour

lines.description: katana-full-setup only: estimated data lines to import, $0.10 each, $4,000 minimum

tier.description: ai-we-build-and-run only: monthly tier in USD (Entry, Growth, or Continuous)
